integrity: Analytic proof from vertex hull and strict facet conditions; supplementary exact rational finite tests do not replace a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact equality is restricted to the pair-constrained convex-body family in dimensions at least three and its affine images. The infimum need not be attained. Neither the universal maximum nor ordinary illumination numbers are determined. Historical priority beyond inspected primary sources is not certified.
title: Exact quantitative illumination of the polars of type-\(D\) root polytopes
